name: Windswept Milk and Mold: the objective areas are on the Shadewell Spring map where Almo gives them (COA-9584)
contract: Windswept Milk 175074 and Windswept Mold 175075 are given by Grand Cheesemonger Almo at Shadewell Spring (WorldMapAreaId 2027); their objective areas lie on the Scadeald map (2062).

A real client asks CMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY (483) and reads SMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY_RESPONSE (484): quest count, quest id, POI count, then per POI its id, objective index, map, area, floor, priority, flags, point count and points.
Each quest now sends four POIs: the objective area on Scadeald, the turn-in on Shadewell Spring, the same objective area on Shadewell Spring (POI 2, at byte 180) and the same turn-in on Scadeald.
These are data assertions on the bytes the server sends; the harness cannot see the client's tracker.

steps.label: Ask the map to mark 175074, as the quest log does
